title: Kula Today
heading: Today · Wed 25 Nov
summary: A flat day (forecast light). Thermals stayed flat all day. The upslope ran from about 08:45 to about 17:35. Yesterday evening, the page called it normal, about 5,600 ft, a hit. Midday the base averaged about 5,000 ft by the Kekoa camera, 600 ft lower than yesterday evening's number; the morning update said about 5,600 ft, off by 600 ft; at 10:00, from the 09:00 base, about 4,800 ft, off by 200 ft. Most of the day the shear line was north of Makawao. Data gaps: no readings all day from 3 stations (Kahikinui, Nakula, Upper Kahikinui); the Mesonet could not be reached on 44 of 53 updates.
